verdict.rationale: The Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme is a laptop processor (CPU/NPU silicon). Opting out of having your data used to train AI models is a policy of data-collecting services, not a capability a chip ships, so the story does not apply to this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows Qualcomm offering any training-data control: the on-device AI and AI Hub materials cover running and optimizing models, not data-use opt-outs.
